title: Understanding Pipe Slope and Drainage Fundamentals
description: Gravity is the primary force moving wastewater through a drainage system, making correct pipe slope essential for proper operation. If a horizontal drain pipe is pitched too steeply, liquid wastewater rushes past solid waste, leaving the solids behind to accumulate and cause clogs. Conversely, insufficient slope fails to provide the necessary velocity to carry debris away. Maintaining the correct grade specified by local code ensures both liquids and solids move consistently toward the main sewer. Proper alignment and support prevent sagging over time, protecting the integrity of the drainage network.
caption:
Understanding Pipe Slope and Drainage Fundamentals

Gravity is the primary force moving wastewater through a drainage system, making correct pipe slope essential for proper operation. If a horizontal drain pipe is pitched too steeply, liquid wastewater rushes past solid waste, leaving the solids behind to accumulate and cause clogs. Conversely, insufficient slope fails to provide the necessary velocity to carry debris away. Maintaining the correct grade specified by local code ensures both liquids and solids move consistently toward the main sewer. Proper alignment and support prevent sagging over time, protecting the integrity of the drainage network.
